headline: Saturn now has a 10-sided pattern at its south pole
standfirst: Scientists just spotted a new atmospheric shape on the planet.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: A massive 10-sided atmospheric pattern has emerged at Saturn's south pole.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: Hubble telescope data shows this decagon appeared only in the last few years.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: It gives the planet a strange new counterpart to its famous northern hexagon.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Researchers are tracking the pattern as it continues to grow stronger.

caption:
NASA scientists have discovered a new 10-sided pattern forming on Saturn.

This decagon is still developing at the planet's south pole. It is a surprising addition to the well-known hexagon already circling the north pole.

Do you think we will find similar geometric patterns on other gas giants in our solar system?
